context: Two managers run through a compliance briefing checklist
purpose: Teach: 異動/労務/留意/外貨/日本銀行/包括/指令/多大

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: では、コンプライアンス研修のチェックリストを順番に確認していきましょう。今回の人事異動でメンバーも変わりましたから。
lines.en: Alright, let's go through the compliance briefing checklist in order. Our members changed with this recent personnel transfer.
lines.style: Calm professional tone, measured pace, slightly formal business register.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: そうですね。まず労務管理の項目ですが、新人への説明は今週中に終わらせる予定です。
lines.en: Right. First, regarding the labor management items, I plan to finish explaining them to the new hires by the end of this week.
lines.style: Steady businesslike delivery, confident with mild deference to colleague.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 助かります。それと、海外取引の留意点も忘れずに伝えてください。特に外貨建ての契約は要注意です。
lines.en: That helps. Also, please don't forget to convey the precautions about overseas transactions. Foreign currency contracts especially require care.
lines.style: Polite request with subtle warning, measured emphasis on key terms.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。先週、日本銀行が新しいガイドラインを出しましたよね。あれも資料に追加しておきます。
lines.en: Understood. The Bank of Japan issued new guidelines last week, didn't they? I'll add those to the materials as well.
lines.style: Acknowledging response, slightly brisk and proactive in nature.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ぜひお願いします。本社からの包括的な指令もありますので、それに沿った形で進めましょう。
lines.en: Please do. There's also a comprehensive directive from headquarters, so let's proceed in line with that.
lines.style: Collaborative but firm, conveying authority from above respectfully.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 了解です。違反があれば会社に多大な損害が出ますから、慎重にやらないといけませんね。
lines.en: Got it. If there's a violation, the company would suffer enormous damage, so we have to be careful.
lines.style: Serious sober tone, acknowledging gravity with quiet resolve.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ええ。来週の月曜までに最終版を共有してください。私の方でも一度目を通します。
lines.en: Yes. Please share the final version by next Monday. I'll also look it over once on my end.
lines.style: Concluding businesslike instruction, polite but clearly directive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: かしこまりました。金曜日までには下書きをお送りします。
lines.en: Certainly. I'll send you the draft by Friday.
lines.style: Formal closing reply, deferential and reliably committed.
